Sol.468.(b) affects the character
The  given  sentence  needs  a verb, not the noun 'effects' for the subject 'the plot of the story'. 'The plot of the story' is a singular subject that will take 'affects' as a singular verb. Hence, 'affects the character' is the most appropriate answer.
Sol.469.(b) despite decades of
'Despite' does  not  take  'of'.  Therefore,  'of'  will  be  removed. Hence, 'despite decades of' is the most appropriate answer.
Sol.470.(b) had left before I reached
If two actions took place in the past then the 1st action must be in the Past perfect tense (Had + V 3 ) and the 2nd action must be in the Simple Past tense(V 2 ). In the given sentence, 'train leaving' is  the  first  action,  so  it  will  be  written  in  past  perfect  tense. Hence, 'had left(V 3 ) before I reached(V 2 )' is the most appropriate

texts.orig: If two actions took place in the past then the 1st action must be in the Past perfect tense (Had + V 3 ) and the 2nd action must be in the Simple Past tense(V 2 ). In the given sentence, 'train leaving' is  the  first  action,  so  it  will  be  written  in  past  perfect  tense. Hence, 'had left(V 3 ) before I reached(V 2 )' is the most appropriate
